claim: Centralize belief-graph I/O through CB.Belief.Store: route the three readers that bypass it - CB.Codepath.Predicates (predicates.ex), CB.Belief.EditPairs (edit_pairs.ex), and the CB.Belief.Adjudication race-guard re-read (adjudication.ex) - through Store.read, so Store becomes the sole place that knows the on-disk layout. Precondition for per-belief storage (cb:b554).

evidence.detail: Discharged 2026-07-06: the three bypass readers (CB.Codepath.Predicates, CB.Belief.EditPairs, the CB.Belief.Adjudication race-guard re-read) route through Store.read/read_raw, and two path-parameterized readers the plan had not named (CB.Collection.load, cb.import.eval's read_collection) share the same loader, so Store is the sole place that knows the on-disk layout. Landed with the layout-aware store.
